editorial: Feeling the raw desperation of a neo-noir crime thriller, your attention is immediately seized by the sheer volatility of this world. The melding of historical gangster life with temporal science creates a genuinely unique, high-concept ride. The palpable emotional weight connecting the main trio shines through even during the most violent sequences. While the third act occasionally feels rushed in its attempt to tie up every paradox, the electric chemistry between the ensemble keeps you committed to the ride. You will find yourself contemplating the nature of fate after the credits roll, making this an incredibly immersive experience.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of complex genre mashups who appreciate the weight of destiny and the heat of a good heist.
